title: Design guidance for filleting of selective laser melted metal parts (Burns, Hafiychuk, Hafiychuk, Wheeler, NASA/TM-20250010927, December 2025)
publisher: National Aeronautics and Space Administration, Langley Research Center

The server record marks it public, public use permitted, with no third-party material; some authors are contractor staff. Ti-6Al-4V on an SLM 280 at 60 micrometre layers, one confirmation print, fillets 0.125 inch long. Finding: a circular fillet built across the layers becomes an unsupported overhang past 45 degrees and the residual-stress deformation grows with the unsupported length; elliptical fillets and fillets finished by a 45 degree tangent reduce it. It is about build orientation and overhang, on another alloy and on fillets about eight to sixteen times larger than the 0.2 and 0.4 mm studied here. It gives no minimum radius and no as-built radius measurement.
